items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: I heard the P-Rone band once or twice.

ctx.x: But for solo, sitting there with his arm, solo. Did you ever hear the P-Rone band? I heard the P-Rone band once or twice. They was playing on a roof garden here. Oh, up there on the Gravier about? Yeah, Gravier. That was his favorite spot. He had that spot sold up. And whenever it would be a dance up at the roof garden, it would be P-Rone. Remember who was the drummer? I don't know who was the drummer for P-Rone at that time.
There was one man, you know, Louis Cartrell's father, the old man Cartrell, Louis Cartrell. They played with P-Rone a long time. I just wondered if you remembered hearing him. I don't know.
